theorems.name: Submission.bv_compactness_uniform_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Set (Rn n)) (u : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ), IsOpen W → volume W < ⊤ → ⨆ k, (∫⁻ x in W, ‖u k x‖ₑ + Chapter02.bvVariationOn (u k) W) < ⊤ → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ k, (∫⁻ x in W, ‖u k x‖ₑ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c ∧ Chapter02.bvVariationOn (u k) W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
